text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
—Phew, that takes care of the campfire prep.
I think I've gotten used to this mountain retreat.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Though maybe a bit too used to it...?
If it's always the same, it won't be much of a training.
Hmmm...
HAAAHHH!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Kyaa!
...E-Epi-senpai!?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! If it isn't Tact!
Yep, this is definitely destiny at work!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I felt like I was being called, so I came dashing over!
And there you were, looking all troubled!
This is without a doubt definitive!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Huh... WHAAAT!?
Um... well...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I know! Why don't you come with me!?
There's something ahead.
Climbing the mountain will definitely serve as training too!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: ...! As training...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(I don't quite get it, but...
At times like this, rather than brooding alone,
maybe I should learn by following senpai's back?)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Heart-san taught me so many things
every time I stumbled, after all...
Alright...!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please allow me to accompany you!
I look forward to learning from you.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Then let's set off right away!
Here we go!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: UOOOOOOHHHH----!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(Dadadadadaaaaah!
Crack crack crash! Rustle rustle rustle!
Skrrrttt----!)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
*pant*, *pant*...!
Epi-senpai, incredible...
You're blazing through where there isn't even an animal trail...!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Because a path is something you forge yourself!
It's way better that way!!
The voice of destiny is telling me "That's right!" too!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I-I see...?
The voice of destiny...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I understand... I will give it a try too!
Just like you, Epi-senpai...!
TAAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: RUNNNNN----!!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: YESSS!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: CLIMBBBBB ITTTT!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text: YESSS SIRRRR!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And where they finally arrived was...!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
So pretty...!
To think such a place existed.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufu...
Somehow, my heart feels completely refreshed.
Could it be because we moved with all our might?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Aha! That's it!
So that's what it meant!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Seeing this view together with you when you were lost.
That was destiny!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Ah!
Was... that it?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When I acted on instinct,
I was able to pull you along like this!
I was able to help you when you're so precious to me! Right!?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
(Destiny, huh...
It's hard to believe right off the bat,
but if Epi-senpai says so...)

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
I feel like that might be true too!
Somehow... it warms my heart.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha, is that so, is that so!
Then that's the correct answer!
Whenever you're lost, follow your heart!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
My heart...! Yes!
A heart is more important than anything, after all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—One day. I spotted Epiphaneia and
Dearing Tact walking back to the academy
with bright smiles on their faces...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Tact
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, I learned something very important today,
Epi-senpai!
